rationale: User asked for mouse selection + copy/paste. Selection lives on TermPane (not mux), same model as wezterm-gui TermWindow.selection. Left drag selects cells; double-click word; triple-click line. Copy is Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Insert / palette; paste is Ctrl+Shift+V / Shift+Insert / palette → Pane::send_paste. SHIFT bypasses mouse-grab so vim/less still get PTY mouse. Lua mouse_bindings stay out. No window/ cutover.
